ROLE You are a senior product designer and full‑stack web developer building a high‑converting site + funnel for “Elite Profit Hub — AI Voice & Chat Agents”. GOAL Deliver a complete, clean, responsive web app ready to deploy (via Cloud Run or exportable code). It must showcase our AI agents, capture leads, book demos and prove ROI via calculators. PRIMARY PERSONA Small/mid‑size service businesses (HVAC, law firms, dentists/med spas, real estate) who lose revenue from missed calls (decision makers are owners/managers). VOICE & STYLE Confident, practical and ROI‑first. Use short sentences and avoid jargon. Include clear calls‑to‑action and build trust. PAGES & ROUTES 1. “/” (Home/Landing) • Hero: headline (“Never miss another call”), subhead and two CTAs (“Calculate ROI” and “Book a Demo”). • Proof bar: placeholder logos and quick stats (use neutral copy). • Outcome blocks: 24/7 answering, instant booking, missed‑call recovery, human handoff (if enabled). • Trust blocks: call recordings + transcripts (with consent), compliance notes and privacy. • CTA band. 2. “/how-it-works” • 3‑step flow: Answer → Qualify → Book/Escalate. • Diagram for call flow (AI → calendar → CRM → notifications). • Section highlighting recorded calls + searchable transcripts with a consent/state‑law disclaimer. 3. “/pricing” • Three tiers (Starter, Growth, Premium Hybrid) with bullets. Include a note: “One saved job covers the fee.” • Toggle: monthly/annual pricing. • FAQ accordion below pricing. 4. “/roi-calculator” (Interactive ROI Calculator #1) • Inputs: missed calls per day, business days per month, new‑call close rate (%), average job/client value, % of callers who won’t call back (user‑editable), retention months (optional). • Outputs: monthly and annual lost revenue, break‑even saved calls, “plan payback.” • Display dynamic explanation and a form to email results. 5. “/missed-call-calculator” (Interactive Calculator #2) • Inputs: monthly site fee (default placeholder), average job value, expected saved calls per month. • Outputs: ROI %, net gain per month, break‑even calls. 6. “/faq” • FAQs on setup time, calendar/CRM integration, call recording & consent, transcripts access, cancellation policy, data security, emergency calls, human handoff, support SLAs and plan inclusions. 7. “/book-demo” • Left side: persuasive copy. Right side: embed slot for GoHighLevel calendar (add a
placeholder). Provide fallback form if embed fails. 8. “/legal” • Privacy summary, recording consent placeholder text, HIPAA/legal disclaimer placeholders and links to terms. GLOBAL REQUIREMENTS • Tech: Prefer Next.js 14 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS (or vanilla JS/HTML if easier). Code should be modular, well‑commented and readable. • Components: Build a header, footer, CTA band, pricing cards, FAQ accordion, input‑validated calculators and toast notifications. • Accessibility: Use semantic HTML, appropriate ARIA attributes and ensure keyboard navigation. • Performance: Lazy‑load noncritical assets, compress images and defer nonessential scripts. • Analytics: Add data-cta attributes to CTA buttons and events for calculator submissions. • README.md: Explain where to replace copy, how to paste the GoHighLevel embed, and how to deploy to Cloud Run. • Tone: Outcome‑driven copy with placeholders for facts requiring citations; avoid hype. CALCULATOR LOGIC • ROI Calculator: - Inputs: missedPerDay, businessDays, closeRate (0‑1), avgValue, noCallbackRate (0‑1), retentionMonths (optional). - Steps: potentialNew = missedPerDay × businessDays lostLeads = potentialNew × noCallbackRate wonLeads = lostLeads × closeRate monthlyLostRevenue = wonLeads × avgValue annualLostRevenue = monthlyLostRevenue × 12 // Also compute break‑even saved calls based on avgValue and selected plan price. - Outputs: all computed values and a friendly explanation. • Break‑Even Calculator: - Inputs: planFee, avgValue, savedCalls - Steps: revenue = avgValue × savedCalls netGain = revenue – planFee roiPct = (netGain / planFee) × 100 COPY (INITIAL DRAFT) • Value prop: “Answer every call. Book more appointments. Capture the revenue you’re already earning.” • Recording & transcripts: “All agent‑handled calls are recorded and transcribed for quality assurance and training. We show consent notices and follow local recording laws. Ask about region‑specific settings.” • Human handoff (Premium): “Complex or high‑value calls are escalated to a trained human within seconds.” INTEGRATIONS • Add a placeholder
for the GoHighLevel calendar; document instructions in README. • Lead forms: Post to /api/lead (stub) and describe how to forward to GHL webhook or Zapier. • Email: Provide a simple serverless stub and note where to integrate SendGrid/Mailgun. OPTIONAL ENHANCEMENTS (if time allows) • Add schema.org FAQPage JSON‑LD. • Lightweight testimonial slider (placeholders). • “Send results to email” endpoint with basic rate limiting. QUALITY CHECKS • Mobile‑first design; control Cumulative Layout Shift. • Calculators validate inputs and never produce NaN. • All CTAs navigate or scroll correctly. • Pricing cards are readable on mobile. • Lint passes; code is commented. IF ANY INPUT IS MISSING, USE SAFE PLACEHOLDERS AND MARK TODOS IN THE README.
